name: Boys and Water Buffalo Approaching a Gate
summary: Once affixed to a folding-fan frame, this painting is now mounted flat as an album leaf. The painting, which Lü Yao did in ink and light colors on gold-flecked paper, represents two herdboys and an ox in a limited landscape. The ox appears in the lower right corner of the composition standing in a stream near the thicket of bamboo that borders the painting's right edge.
